v1.0.0 OpenAPI 3.0.3 # Formalize Public API Download OpenAPI Document json Download OpenAPI Document yaml This documentation aims to provide all the information you need to work with our API. # Authenticating requests To authenticate requests, include an **Authorization** header with the value: **Bearer {YOUR\_API\_TOKEN}**. You can retrieve your token by visiting your Settings -> API and Integrations -> API Tokens -> **New API Token**. # Sending requests Include an **Accept** header with the value **application/json** in all requests. # Working with files [Read the files documentation](https://intercom-help.eu/formalize/en/articles/566810-public-api-file-upload) to learn how to work with files. # Rate limiting You are allowed to make 750 requests per minute. You are allowed to make 20.000 requests a day. Server Server:https://api.formalize.com ## AuthenticationRequired Selected Auth Type: default | | | --- | | Bearer Token :
Show Password | Client Libraries Shell Ruby Node.js PHP Python MoreSelect from all clients Shell Curl ## Assets ​Copy link A tracked company hardware asset like pc's and servers. Assets support hierarchical parent/child connections, letting you model a chain of linked assets and traverse it through the API. Assets Operations - get/public/v1/assets - post/public/v1/assets - get/public/v1/assets/{id} - patch/public/v1/assets/{id} - delete/public/v1/assets/{id} ### List assets ​Copy link Auth Required This endpoint allows you to get a paginated list of assets. Query Parameters - updated\_afterCopy link to updated\_after Type: string Examples 2026-09-17T00:00:002026-09-17T00:00:00 ISO 8601 timestamp. Only return assets with a recorded change after this time. Has to be at least 30 mins in the past. - pageCopy link to page Type: integer Examples 1212 The page number to get. Default = 1 - page\_sizeCopy link to page\_size Type: integer Examples 1212 The number of items per page. Default = 10. Maximum = 200 Responses - 200 application/json Request Example for get/public/v1/assets Shell Curl ```curl curl https://api.formalize.com/public/v1/assets \ --header 'Authorization: Bearer Body required application/json - nameCopy link to name Type: string required Example Audit Report2 - descriptionCopy link to description Type: string Example Used to track the findings from compliance audits. Very important for business HTML is allowed.
